INSERT INTO ops.process_document_scan_state AS scan (
    process_id,
    secop_portfolio_id,
    source_updated_at,

    scan_status,
    last_scanned_at,
    next_scan_at,

    attempts,
    documents_found,
    last_error,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1::UUID,

    $2::TEXT,

    NULLIF(
        $3::TEXT,
        ''
    )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    'success',

    NOW(),

    NOW() + $4::INTERVAL,

    1,

    $5::BIGINT,

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-003',

        'secop_process_id',
        $6::TEXT,

        'reference',
        $7::TEXT,

        'opening_status',
        $8::TEXT,

        'process_status',
        $9::TEXT,

        'scan_result',
        $10::TEXT,

        'documents_found',
        $11::BIGINT,

        'storage_policy',
        'metadata_only',

        'binary_downloaded',
        FALSE,

        'scanned_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (process_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    secop_portfolio_id =
        EXCLUDED.secop_portfolio_id,

    source_updated_at =
        EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,

    scan_status =
        'success',

    last_scanned_at =
        NOW(),

    next_scan_at =
        EXCLUDED.next_scan_at,

    attempts =
        scan.attempts + 1,

    documents_found =
        EXCLUDED.documents_found,

    last_error =
        NULL,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            scan.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    process_id,
    secop_portfolio_id,
    scan_status,

    last_scanned_at,
    next_scan_at,

    attempts,
    documents_found,
    metadata;

WITH process_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        process.id AS process_id,

        process.secop_process_id,
        process.reference,
        process.process_name,

        NULLIF(
            process.raw_json
                ->> 'id_del_portafolio',
            ''
        ) AS secop_portfolio_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                process.raw_json
                    ->> 'fecha_de_ultima_publicaci',
                ''
            )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

            process.updated_at
        ) AS source_updated_at,

        process.raw_json
            ->> 'estado_de_apertura_del_proceso'
            AS opening_status,

        process.raw_json
            ->> 'estado_del_procedimiento'
            AS process_status

    FROM secop.processes AS process

    WHERE process.raw_json IS NOT NULL
      AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saas.process_matches m WHERE m.process_id=process.id)
        OR (COALESCE(process.awarded,FALSE)=FALSE AND process.response_deadline >= NOW()))

      AND NULLIF(
          process.raw_json
              ->> 'id_del_portafolio',
          ''
      ) IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    candidate.process_id,
    candidate.secop_process_id,
    candidate.reference,
    candidate.process_name,

    candidate.secop_portfolio_id,
    candidate.source_updated_at,

    candidate.opening_status,
    candidate.process_status,

    scan.scan_status,
    scan.last_scanned_at,
    scan.next_scan_at,
    scan.attempts,
    scan.documents_found

FROM process_candidates AS candidate

LEFT JOIN ops.process_document_scan_state AS scan
    ON scan.process_id =
       candidate.process_id

WHERE
    (
        candidate.opening_status
            ILIKE 'Abierto'

        OR candidate.source_updated_at >=
            NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'
    )

  AND (
      scan.process_id IS NULL

      OR scan.scan_status = 'failed'

      OR candidate.source_updated_at >
          COALESCE(
              scan.source_updated_at,
              '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'
                  ::TIMESTAMPTZ
          )

      OR (
          scan.next_scan_at IS NOT NULL
          AND scan.next_scan_at <= NOW()
      )
  )

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN scan.process_id IS NULL
            THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END ASC,

    candidate.source_updated_at DESC,
    candidate.secop_process_id ASC

LIMIT 25;

UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor
SET
    active_execution_id =
        $1::TEXT,

    lock_acquired_at =
        NOW(),

    lock_expires_at =
        NOW() + INTERVAL '30 minutes',

    status =
        'running',

    last_run_at =
        NOW(),

    error_message =
        NULL,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            cursor.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-003',

            'current_execution_id',
            $2::TEXT,

            'current_execution_batches',
            0,

            'current_execution_processes',
            0,

            'current_execution_documents',
            0,

            'current_execution_started_at',
            NOW(),

            'storage_policy',
            'metadata_only',

            'binary_download_enabled',
            FALSE
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

WHERE cursor.source_code =
    'SECOP_II_DOCUMENTS_2025'

  AND (
      cursor.active_execution_id IS NULL

      OR cursor.lock_expires_at IS NULL

      OR cursor.lock_expires_at <= NOW()

      OR cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $3::TEXT
  )

RETURNING
    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.cursor_timestamp,
    cursor.cursor_process_id,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.status,
    cursor.records_processed,
    cursor.metadata;

WITH cursor_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        cursor.cursor_timestamp,
        cursor.cursor_process_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_batches',
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            0
        ) AS current_batches,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_processes',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS current_processes,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                cursor.metadata
                    ->> 'current_execution_documents',
                ''
            )::BIGINT,
            0
        ) AS current_documents

    FROM ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_DOCUMENTS_2025'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
        $1::TEXT
),

run_finished AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        batches_processed =
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    run.batches_processed,
                    0
                ),
                cursor_snapshot.current_batches
            ),

        records_read =
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    run.records_read,
                    0
                ),
                cursor_snapshot.current_processes
            ),

        records_written =
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    run.records_written,
                    0
                ),
                cursor_snapshot.current_documents
            ),

        cursor_end_timestamp =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_timestamp,

        cursor_end_process_id =
            cursor_snapshot.cursor_process_id,

        completion_reason =
            $2::TEXT,

        error_node =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        error_details =
            '{}'::JSONB,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'completion_reason',
                $3::TEXT,

                'processes_scanned',
                cursor_snapshot.current_processes,

                'documents_found',
                cursor_snapshot.current_documents,

                'storage_policy',
                'metadata_only',

                'binary_download_enabled',
                FALSE,

                'finished_execution_id',
                $4::TEXT,

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM cursor_snapshot

    WHERE run.n8n_execution_id =
        $5::TEXT

      AND run.workflow_code =
        'WF-003'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.n8n_execution_id,
        run.status,

        run.started_at,
        run.finished_at,

        run.batches_processed,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written,

        run.completion_reason,
        run.metadata
),

cursor_released AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors AS cursor

    SET
        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        status =
            'success',

        last_success_at =
            NOW(),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                (
                    (
                        (
                            (
                                COALESCE(
                                    cursor.metadata,
                                    '{}'::JSONB
                                )
                                - 'current_execution_id'
                            )
                            - 'current_execution_batches'
                        )
                        - 'current_execution_processes'
                    )
                    - 'current_execution_documents'
                )
                - 'current_execution_started_at'
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-003',

                'last_completion_reason',
                $6::TEXT,

                'last_completed_execution_id',
                $7::TEXT,

                'last_execution_batches',
                cursor_snapshot.current_batches,

                'last_execution_processes',
                cursor_snapshot.current_processes,

                'last_execution_documents',
                cursor_snapshot.current_documents,

                'storage_policy',
                'metadata_only',

                'binary_download_enabled',
                FALSE,

                'last_completed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM cursor_snapshot

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
        'SECOP_II_DOCUMENTS_2025'

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
        $8::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.records_processed,
        cursor.last_success_at,
        cursor.metadata,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    cursor_released.source_code,
    cursor_released.status,

    cursor_released.active_execution_id,
    cursor_released.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor_released.lock_expires_at,

    cursor_released.records_processed,
    cursor_released.last_success_at,
    cursor_released.metadata,

    run_finished.id
        AS workflow_run_id,

    run_finished.n8n_execution_id,
    run_finished.started_at,
    run_finished.finished_at,

    run_finished.batches_processed,
    run_finished.records_read,
    run_finished.records_written,

    run_finished.completion_reason

FROM cursor_released

LEFT JOIN run_finished
    ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO secop.process_documents AS document (
    external_document_id,
    process_id,
    secop_portfolio_id,

    contract_number,
    file_name,
    file_size_bytes,
    file_extension,
    description,
    uploaded_at,

    entity_name,
    entity_nit,

    download_url,
    download_url_text,

    download_policy,
    relevance_status,
    download_status,
    extraction_status,

    raw_json,

    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES (
    $1::TEXT,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            $2::TEXT,
            ''
        )::UUID,

        (
            SELECT
                process.id

            FROM secop.processes
                AS process

            WHERE process.raw_json
                    ->> 'id_del_portafolio'
                  =
                  $3::TEXT

            ORDER BY
                process.updated_at DESC,
                process.id ASC

            LIMIT 1
        )
    ),

    $3::TEXT,

    NULLIF(
        $4::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    NULLIF(
        $5::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    NULLIF(
        $6::TEXT,
        ''
    )::BIGINT,

    NULLIF(
        $7::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    NULLIF(
        $8::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    NULLIF(
        $9::TEXT,
        ''
    )::TIMESTAMPTZ,

    NULLIF(
        $10::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    NULLIF(
        $11::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            $12::TEXT,
            ''
        ),
        '{}'
    )::JSONB,

    NULLIF(
        $13::TEXT,
        ''
    ),

    'metadata_only',
    'pending',
    'not_requested',
    'not_requested',

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            $14::TEXT,
            ''
        ),
        '{}'
    )::JSONB,

    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT (external_document_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    process_id =
        COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.process_id,
            document.process_id
        ),

    secop_portfolio_id =
        EXCLUDED.secop_portfolio_id,

    contract_number =
        EXCLUDED.contract_number,

    file_name =
        EXCLUDED.file_name,

    file_size_bytes =
        EXCLUDED.file_size_bytes,

    file_extension =
        EXCLUDED.file_extension,

    description =
        EXCLUDED.description,

    uploaded_at =
        EXCLUDED.uploaded_at,

    entity_name =
        EXCLUDED.entity_name,

    entity_nit =
        EXCLUDED.entity_nit,

    download_url =
        EXCLUDED.download_url,

    download_url_text =
        EXCLUDED.download_url_text,

    raw_json =
        EXCLUDED.raw_json,

    last_seen_at =
        NOW(),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    external_document_id,
    process_id,
    secop_portfolio_id,

    file_name,
    file_size_bytes,
    file_extension,

    download_policy,
    download_status,
    extraction_status,

    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at;
